description: This file implements the MessageUnit class, which handles serialization, updating, opening, closing, and message pushing functionalities within the Thunder messaging framework. It includes nested handler classes for control iteration and manages message dispatching, control enabling/disabling, and resource management.

classes.name: MessageUnit
classes.description: Main class managing messaging operations, including serialization, control updates, resource management, and message dispatching within the Thunder framework.

classes.name: Handler
classes.description: Nested control handler classes used for iterating over controls to perform specific actions such as serialization, enabling/disabling, and destruction.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes control data into a buffer, either for a specific module or all modules, and returns the number of bytes written.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates control states based on provided metadata and desired enable/disable status.

methods.name: Update (no parameters)
methods.description: Updates control states based on stored settings.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of MessageUnit.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Initializes the MessageUnit with a specified path, configuration, and mode, setting up dispatchers and environment.

methods.name: Open (with instanceId)
methods.description: Initializes the MessageUnit for a specific instance ID, used in OOP components.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes and cleans up resources, including dispatchers and redirected streams.

methods.name: Default
methods.description: Determines if a control is enabled by default based on settings.

methods.name: Push
methods.description: Pushes a message and its information to the buffer or directly outputs it if in direct mode.
